articles.title: A Space Blast That Kept Flashing for 27 Days
articles.summary: Astronomers found GRB 220706A, whose engine flashed in X-rays for around 27 days, far longer than the old record, and scientists still do not know what powered it.

articles.title: Meet D-Rex, a Giant Fungus
articles.summary: Scientists found a giant fungus in Yunnan nicknamed D-rex, whose family may have begun just after the dinosaurs died out.

articles.title: A Shipwreck That May Be the World's Oldest
articles.summary: A wreck off Kekova, Turkey, may date to 2700-2400 BCE from its pottery cargo, but the dating is still being checked and has not yet been peer-reviewed.
